records.environment: Google Chrome on macOS, desktop window, public production demo
records.scenario: Loaded the Beijing board and completed left, up and right moves through the game's accessible controls.
records.result: Controls responded, matching buildings merged, score advanced from 0 to 4, the Hutong cluster unlocked and progress persisted locally. The immediate feedback and readable city-building progression support a bounded editorial recommendation.
records.limitations: Brief representative session only; no mobile, long-session, performance, every-city, save-recovery or source/deployment parity test.
